about: The inputs the ndpi profile rejects, each with the start of its message (the Rust tests' prefix, or what each store test's message contains), and, where the Python host rejects it earlier, the host's message. rust/refkv-ir/build.rs writes a Rust test per case into tests/ndpi.rs; python/tests/ir/test_rejects.py checks each through the host and that every rejected fixture is listed here.

cases.message: NDPI levels differ in compression (7, the first's 22610)
NDPI focal planes (two levels with one magnification) are not supported
NDPI level 0's JPEG frame of 64 × 16 pixels has other MCU rows or columns than its 64 × 17
NDPI levels do not decrease in size
an NDPI level's JPEG XR pixel format 24C3DD6F034EFE4BB1853D77768DC911 is not supported
NDPI levels' JPEG XR pixel formats differ
an NDPI level's JPEG XR stream has no container header with a pixel format and size
an NDPI tile is outside the file
an NDPI level's tile high bytes differ in length from its tiles
an NDPI JPEG XR stream of 32 × 32 pixels is not its chunk's 64 × 64
an NDPI JPEG XR level has neither tiles nor exactly one strip
an NDPI level has 5 tile offsets and 5 byte counts, not its 6 tiles
McuStarts does not match the strip's intervals
an NDPI strip has no SOF0 or no restart interval
an NDPI strip of 3 bytes is shorter than 4
an NDPI chunk would be 65536 pixels wide, more than 65535
